title.narrative: ODIHR ENGAGEMENT IN AND SUPPORT FOR UKRAINE

description.narrative: ODIHR’s project Advancing the Human Dimension of Security in Ukraine focuses on the promotion of co-operation in the human dimension, using civil society networks, effectively strengthening existing partnerships and building new partnerships with government stakeholders in the fields of human rights monitoring, democratic governance and law-making, and tolerance and non-discrimination. It enhances the effective mechanisms of multi-stakeholder dialogue on human dimension issues, including human rights monitoring and advocacy, gender equality, human rights compliant policing, political rights of persons with disabilities, freedom of assembly, public integrity, anti-torture initiatives, and a human rights-based approach towards victims of trafficking in human beings.
